newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Marine FA-18 crashes in Yellow Sea.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Marine FA-18 crashes in Yellow Sea.

text.p: A U.S. Marine FA-18 Delta Hornet fighter plane crashed into the Yellow Sea off Korea and its two crew members were missing, a Pentagon spokesman said on Sunday.
He said the plane was on a training mission and was seen going down by an accompanying fighter from the U.S. base at Iwakumi base in Japan.
The crash took place at 2:10 a.m. local time (6:10 a.m. EST) (1110 GMT) about 45 miles (72 km) west of Osan, Korea, the spokesman said.
Two U.S. Air Force helicopters and two South Korean navy ships searched for the crew members.
